subject: Vendor profile compaction and Vendr migration - BlueBridge
messages:
From: Claire Nguyen <claire@bluebridge.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor profile compaction request / Vendr migration - BlueBridge

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. As discussed, BlueBridge is consolidating vendor profiles and planning to migrate our security profile from Whistic into Vendr the week of 3/22. We need Redwood's help to minimize the evidence set we surface during the migration — our security team is short on time and would prefer a "compact" profile that maps only required SIG/CAIQ items for production integrations.

Attached is a current export from Whistic with our most recent uploads. Can your team do a quick sweep and tell us which items are absolutely required for the Vendr transfer and which can be deferred to the 60-day post-migration window? Ideally we get a checklist and a recommended minimal attachments list so we can schedule a single upload.

Attachments: [Attachment: bluebridge_whistic_export.csv (CSV, 2.3MB)]

Best,
Claire Nguyen
Senior Security Program Manager
BlueBridge, Inc.
security@bluebridge.com
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Claire Nguyen <claire@bluebridge.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor profile compaction request / Vendr migration - BlueBridge

Hi Claire — thanks for sending the export. We'll scope a compact set that satisfies SIG/CAIQ "must-haves" for a production inference integration and flag items that can be deferred.

Quick notes / next steps:
- Rishi will run a mapping to SIG v2021/CAIQ and produce a 1-page checklist (required vs optional).
- Marissa will prepare the upload manifest for Vendr so the migration team can use their API to pull the necessary artifacts.
- We'll aim to return the checklist + manifest by end of day Wednesday (3/17).

If anything in the export looks like a blocker (e.g., missing SOC 2 evidence for data-in-transit), we'll call it out in the checklist. Otherwise we expect a single 30–45 minute upload window will be sufficient.

Jasmine Liu
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: forwarded file preserved
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: BlueBridge compact profile mapping (Whistic -> Vendr)

Rishi / Marissa — putting the export you saw from Claire into your inbox. Key constraints from BlueBridge: limited upload bandwidth (one window), they'd like only the absolute required SIG/CAIQ assets migrated now.

Rishi — please prioritize: 1) identify SIG statements with SOC 2 trace (evidence that proves control is in place), 2) mark any CAIQ questions that are blocking for production tokens/embeddings (authN, KMS proofs, HTTPS/TLS configs), and 3) label each item as REQUIRED / DEFERABLE. Deliverable: single-sheet mapping with exact filenames from the export that Redwood should request via Vendr API.

Marissa — I'll need a Vendr manifest template with fields: filename, file-type, evidence-date, claim (SIG ID / CAIQ ID), and upload-scope (immediate / 60d). Also include the Vendr API endpoint and instructions for the BlueBridge upload team (we can provide a presigned S3 approach if Vendr accepts S3 pulls).

Time: can you both turn around by EOD Wed 3/17 so I can consolidate and send to Claire? If you need more time, we should negotiate a two-step migration with Claire now (core controls first).

--
Jasmine
From: Claire Nguyen <claire@bluebridge.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: security@bluebridge.com
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor profile compaction request / Vendr migration - BlueBridge

Thanks — this is perfect. We reviewed the checklist and are comfortable with the compact grouping for initial upload.

Plan:
- BlueBridge will perform a single upload to the Vendr transfer endpoint on Friday 3/19 between 10:00–11:00 PT.
- We will only include items flagged REQUIRED in your mapping; all DEFERABLE items will be scheduled for a 60-day follow-up.
- I have created a transfer ticket in Vendr and added your manifest link: https://vendr.example.com/bluebridge/profile/transfer (transfer id: VB-20270319-07).

Attached: minimal mapping (sig-caiq-minimap.xlsx) and a small downloadable bundle with proofs we plan to upload. Please confirm if presigned S3 pulls are preferred or if Vendr needs direct upload from BlueBridge.

Attachments: [Attachment: sig-caiq-minimap.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)], [Attachment: upload_bundle_v1.zip (ZIP, 4.8MB)]

Appreciate the quick turn. If you want to run a quick smoke-check after the Vendr transfer, we're happy to stand by.

Claire
Senior Security Program Manager
BlueBridge, Inc.
